PORTRAIT
TO COMMISSION
01 · Vice President

Ziad Darras

Vision, strategy, governance and major customer relationships.

Ziad Darras is a technology executive with 25+ years of experience in the ICT , specializing in strategic growth, business development, technology commercialization, and market expansion across the MENA region. As Founder and CEO of ORVIX LLC, he leads strategic partnerships and go-to-market initiatives across enterprise, government, and telecommunications sectors.

Holding a Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Ziad combines extensive technology-sector experience with strong commercial acumen, focusing on cybersecurity, AI-driven networking, digital infrastructure, and emerging technologies.

His leadership is centered on building strategic ecosystems, accelerating market penetration, and transforming innovative technologies into scalable, commercially viable business opportunities.

PORTRAIT
TO COMMISSION
02 · Chief Technology Officer

Daryl Simpson

Technology strategy, architecture, technical delivery and innovation.

Daryl Simpson has spent more than two decades at the front edge of enterprise technology — Cisco, Verizon, KPMG, and World Wide Technology — consulting to Global 100 firms across application development, infrastructure, and artificial intelligence, and earning a cross-section of industry certifications along the way. His work spans financial services, insurance, healthcare, and telecommunications — sectors where regulation, scale, and risk collide. As Chief Technology Officer at Orvix, he leads technology and solutions strategy across the US, Middle East and North Africa, pioneering AI governance for the enterprises that can least afford to get it wrong — helping regulated organizations move AI from pilot to production without trading away security or auditability. He remains, by his own description, a lifelong student of what’s coming next.

PORTRAIT
TO COMMISSION
03 · Chief Marketing Officer

Rimoshka Nabil

Brand, market positioning, demand generation and communications.

Rimoshka Nabil is the Chief Marketing Officer at Orvix, bringing a distinctive combination of strategic marketing, brand development, and creative industry expertise to the global technology and cybersecurity ecosystem.

With a rich multidisciplinary background spanning design, education, and image consulting, she specializes in transforming complex technical solutions into human-centered brand identities.

PORTRAIT
TO COMMISSION
04 · Chief Financial Officer

Marwan Jaffal

Commercial discipline, finance, operating rhythm and scalable execution.

Armed with eight years of rigorous experience in accounting and finance, Marwan has cultivated a career at the intersection of traditional fiscal discipline and cutting-edge operational transformation.

At the core of Marwan’s professional vision is a relentless drive toward total accounting automation. Recognizing that manual data entry and legacy workflows are the primary culprits of human error and inefficiency, he is pioneering a fully automated financial ecosystem at Orvix. By integrating advanced financial technologies, artificial intelligence, and streamlined digital pipelines, the goal is to eliminate operational friction, drastically reduce the margin for error, and shift the accounting function from a reactive administrative chore into a proactive, real-time strategic engine.

Balancing corporate executive leadership with private enterprise ownership, Marwan views automation not just as a tool for cost-cutting, but as an essential roadmap for the future of commerce. This forward-thinking philosophy allows Orvix to stay ahead of industry trends, scale with unprecedented agility, and empowerment.
